name: Page Designer main panes
note: Right Pane displays Property Editor; panes resize via drag splitters, collapse via triangle control at center of splitter

action: resize a pane
where: drag the horizontal or vertical splitter between panes
appears: pane grows or shrinks live as splitter is dragged
result: more or less screen space allocated to that pane

action: collapse or expand a pane
where: small triangle labeled Collapse in the center of each splitter
appears: pane hides or reappears
result: toggles pane visibility to maximize workspace

action: view onscreen Page Designer orientation summary
where: Help menu (top of page) then Getting Started with Page Designer
appears: online summary describing the Page Designer window
result: quick orientation without leaving the page

action: view list of keyboard shortcuts
where: Help menu then Shortcuts
appears: list of keyboard shortcuts dialog
result: developer sees all shortcuts available in Page Designer

name: Left Pane tabs
note: Four tabs across top of left pane; each shows a tree of the corresponding component types created on the page

name: Central Pane tabs
note: Docs text says 'four tabs' but name only three; Gallery is a separate pane docked below the tabs, not itself a tab

action: search for a page within the application
where: Toolbar Page Selector click, then Page Finder dialog tabs, then Search field, Enter or Go
appears: Page Finder dialog with tabs and a Search field
result: filtered list of pages; selecting one navigates to it

name: Page Finder tabs
note: Search field is not case sensitive and supports regular expressions

action: open a page in Page Designer
where: Workspace home, App Builder icon, select application, select page
appears: Page Designer default view for that page
result: page opens for editing

action: jump keyboard focus to Property Editor after selecting a component
where: select a component in left pane or Layout tab
appears: focus moves into the Property Editor pane
result: keyboard-only path from tree or layout to attributes

action: view help for a specific attribute
where: select the attribute in Property Editor, then click Help tab in central pane
appears: Help tab shows documentation for that attribute
result: inline attribute documentation without leaving the page

action: move a tab to a different pane
where: select tab heading or icon, drag and drop onto target pane
appears: tab relocates to the target pane
result: custom pane arrangement persists until layout is reset

action: reset Page Designer pane layout to default
where: Toolbar Utilities menu, then Layout, then Reset Layout
appears: panes and tabs return to default positions
result: undoes manual drag and drop and pane-mode changes

action: switch between Two Pane Mode and Three Pane Mode
where: Toolbar Utilities menu, then Layout, then Two Pane Mode or Three Pane Mode
appears: left pane hides (Two Pane) or shows again (Three Pane)
result: Two Pane shows just central+right pane, e.g. Rendering tree plus Property Editor

name: Utilities ▸ Layout submenu
note: Three Pane Mode is the default (left+central+right); Two Pane Mode hides the left pane

action: add a component from the Gallery via its context menu
where: right-click a component thumbnail in Gallery, context menu, Add To, choose location
appears: context menu listing valid target locations on the page
result: component added at the chosen location, an alternative to drag-and-drop

name: Page Designer toolbar controls (left to right)
note: Order as documented; lock icon appearance changes: clear=unlocked, red=locked by you, red+person=locked by another user

action: navigate to next or previous page number
where: Toolbar Page Selector, Navigate to Next Page (up arrow) or Navigate to Previous Page (down arrow)
appears: page number field changes
result: loads the adjacent page number in Page Designer

action: jump directly to a page by typing its number
where: Toolbar Page Selector field, type page number, click Go
appears: navigates immediately
result: Page Designer loads that page

action: view current errors and warnings on the page
where: Toolbar Show Messages icon
appears: list of current error/warning messages
result: clicking a message moves Property Editor focus to the attribute at fault

action: view lock owner or update the lock comment
where: Toolbar red locked padlock icon (click)
appears: lock owner info and comment field
result: see who locked the page or edit the lock comment

action: undo or redo the last page-data change
where: Toolbar Undo / Redo buttons
appears: prior state restored (Undo) or redone change reapplied (Redo)
result: reverts or reapplies the most recent edit

name: Create menu (+ icon)
note: Order as documented; Page opens Create Page Wizard, Copy Page opens Copy Page Wizard, Breadcrumb Region opens Create Breadcrumb Wizard

name: Utilities menu (wrench icon)
note: Show and Layout are submenus, listed as separate structure entries

name: Utilities ▸ Show submenu
note: Each is a UI toggle: Tooltips enable/disable hover tips, Text Messages Picker toggles the Messages Picker dialog, Layout View toggles the Layout tab itself

action: view page definition as APEXlang text
where: Toolbar Utilities menu, Show APEXlang View
appears: read-only snapshot of the most recently saved page in APEXlang format
result: lets developer inspect page source; unsaved changes are not reflected until saved

action: check application integrity and quality
where: Toolbar Utilities menu, Advisor
appears: Oracle APEX Advisor report
result: lists integrity and quality issues found in the app

action: view cached pages and regions
where: Toolbar Utilities menu, Caching
appears: Caching report page listing Cached Pages and Cached Regions
result: shows what is cached to help improve performance

action: view change history for the current page
where: Toolbar Utilities menu, History
appears: report of changes made to the page
result: audit trail of edits to the page

action: view the page checksum
where: Toolbar Utilities menu, Checksum
appears: checksum value display
result: used to detect out-of-band changes to the page definition

action: export the current page
where: Toolbar Utilities menu, Export
appears: export file creation flow
result: produces an export file of the page

action: delete the current page
where: Toolbar Utilities menu, Delete Page
appears: delete confirmation flow
result: removes the page from the application

action: save the current page
where: Toolbar Save button
appears: page persists; Show Messages may update with new errors/warnings
result: changes committed to the page definition

action: save and immediately run the page
where: Toolbar Save and Run Page button
appears: page saves, then opens the runtime page
result: developer sees the rendered page immediately after saving

action: open the Shared Components page
where: Toolbar Shared Components button
appears: Shared Components page listing all shared component categories
result: navigates away from Page Designer to manage app-wide components

action: create a new component from the tree
where: Left pane Rendering tab, right-click a node for its context menu, or use the Rendering menu at top of tab
appears: context menu with Create/Insert options appropriate to that node type
result: new component such as a region, item, button, or process is added under that node

action: reorder a component within the tree
where: Left pane, drag a component up or down within the tree
appears: component moves between siblings as it is dragged
result: changes the page position or sequence of that component

action: edit a shared attribute across multiple selected components
where: Left pane, select multiple components, then Property Editor
appears: Property Editor shows only attributes common to all selected components
result: editing that attribute updates it on every selected component at once

action: edit a shared component referenced on this page
where: Left pane Page Shared Components tab, select the item, then Edit Component button in right pane
appears: navigates to that shared component's own edit page (e.g. Navigation Bar)
result: opens the shared component for editing outside Page Designer's own attributes

action: create a new dynamic action
where: Left pane Dynamic Actions tab, right-click, context menu
appears: context menu with Create options
result: new dynamic action added to the tree

action: create a new process, computation, or validation
where: Left pane Processing tab, right-click, context menu
appears: context menu with Create options appropriate to the tree location
result: new item added under the corresponding processing point

action: delete, move, or copy a component to another region
where: Layout tab, select the component, right-click for context menu
appears: context menu with Delete/Move/Copy options
result: component removed, relocated, or duplicated into a chosen region

action: place an item next to another item on the same line
where: Layout tab, drag the second item onto the end of the first item, drop in the dark yellow box that appears
appears: dark yellow drop-target box appears when hovering over a valid drop position
result: the two items display side by side in the grid

action: add a new component to the page from the Gallery
where: Gallery at bottom of central pane, drag component up into the desired position within the Layout tab
appears: a drop-target indicator shows the insertion point as you drag
result: new region, item, or button is added at that position

action: enlarge the Layout tab to full size and back
where: Layout tab, Expand button, then Restore button to return
appears: Layout tab grows to fill available space, temporarily hiding other panes
result: more room to work on complex page layouts

action: focus the Layout tab on one region's contents only
where: Layout tab, select a region, Layout menu (right side of pane), Display from Here
appears: the selected region fills the entire Layout tab
result: isolates that region's layout; Display from Page on the same menu restores the full-page view

name: Layout menu (right side of Layout tab)
note: Docs also say this menu customizes the type/amount of info shown and offers delete/move/copy of selected components, but do not name those items individually

action: locate a hidden item not visible in the Layout tab
where: switch to Left pane Rendering tab tree instead
appears: hidden items are listed in the Rendering tree
result: hidden items never display in the Layout tab, only in the Rendering tree

action: search the current page's components for a text value
where: Central pane, Page Search tab, enter term in search field
appears: matching components, attributes, actions and columns are listed
result: quickly locates references to a value across the page

name: Page Search tab options
note: Page Search tab displays to the right of the Layout tab in the central pane

name: Gallery tabs
note: Gallery docks beneath the Layout tab; by default shows only supported controls/components (legacy components have a separate toggle)

action: add a control or component to the page from the Gallery
where: Gallery, select item, drag and drop into Layout tab, or right-click for context menu
appears: either a live drag preview, or a context menu with an Add To option
result: new control/component added to the page at the chosen position

name: Property Editor header controls
note: Common attributes only shown when multiple components are selected; updating one updates all selected components

action: jump directly to a functional attribute group
where: Property Editor header, Go to Group control
appears: dropdown list of functional attribute groups for the selected component
result: Property Editor scrolls to and isolates that group

action: return Property Editor to its default full view
where: Property Editor header, Go to Group, then Expand All
appears: all attribute groups expand and display again
result: undoes a Go to Group jump

action: search for an attribute or group by keyword
where: Property Editor header, Filter Properties field
appears: only groups and attributes containing the keyword remain visible
result: quickly locates a specific attribute; clearing the field restores the default display

action: pin a property filter so it persists while clicking other components
where: Property Editor header, Pin Filter button beside Filter Properties field
appears: filter keyword stays active across item, region and process selections
result: compares the same attribute across many components; clicking Pin Filter again unpins it

name: Code Editor toolbar controls
note: Opened via the Code Editor:SQL Query button (arrow-within-square icon) next to eligible attributes

action: open the full Code Editor for a code attribute
where: Property Editor, attribute field, Code Editor:SQL Query button (arrow-within-square icon)
appears: Code Editor opens as a modal dialog
result: enhanced editing for PL/SQL, SQL, HTML, CSS or JavaScript with syntax highlighting matched to the property

action: undo the last code edit
where: Code Editor toolbar, Undo
appears: reverts the last text change
result: restores the prior code state

action: redo the last undone code edit
where: Code Editor toolbar, Redo
appears: reapplies the undone text change
result: restores the redone code state

action: find text within the code
where: Code Editor toolbar, Find
appears: find box overlay
result: jumps to and highlights matches

action: trigger auto-complete suggestions
where: Code Editor, cursor in code, Auto Complete
appears: suggestion list popup
result: inserts the chosen completion at the cursor

action: validate the entered code
where: Code Editor toolbar, Validate
appears: validation result, with errors highlighted if any
result: confirms code correctness before saving

action: change all occurrences of a selected token at once
where: Code Editor, right-click, context menu, Change All Occurrences
appears: all matching tokens become simultaneously editable
result: renames every occurrence together

action: open the Command Palette
where: Code Editor, right-click, context menu, Command Palette
appears: Command Palette listing over 80 commands
result: runs any editor command by name or search

action: replace text in the code
where: Command Palette, Replace
appears: replace box overlay
result: substitutes matched text

action: cycle a literal value at the cursor to the next or previous option
where: Command Palette, Replace with Next Value / Replace with Previous Value
appears: value under the cursor changes in place
result: quick increment or decrement style edit of literals

action: add a cursor at an arbitrary position
where: click a position, then Shift+Alt+click another position
appears: an additional blinking cursor is added
result: types or edits at multiple locations simultaneously

action: add cursors on the line above or below the current position
where: press Ctrl+Alt+Up or Ctrl+Alt+Down
appears: an additional cursor appears one line up or down at the same column
result: simultaneous multi-line editing
shortcut: Ctrl+Alt+Up or Ctrl+Alt+Down, Option+Command+Up/Down on macOS

action: save and run the page without closing the Code Editor
where: Code Editor, Save and Run Page button
appears: page saves and a rendered runtime version displays
result: lets the developer test a code change immediately

name: Code Editor Settings menu
note: Indentation options: Tab Inserts Spaces, Tab Size, Indent Size. Themes options: Automatic, Light, Dark, High Contrast Dark

action: chat with the APEX Assistant AI inside the Code Editor
where: Code Editor, integrated AI Chat panel, requires Generative AI configured for the workspace
appears: AI chat panel within the Code Editor dialog
result: AI assistance for writing PL/SQL, SQL, HTML, CSS or JavaScript

action: select the Page itself to edit page-level attributes
where: Rendering tab or Layout tab, click the page name node
appears: Property Editor switches to Page attributes
result: lets developer edit page name/title, header/footer text, JavaScript, security, navigation and more

name: Page attribute groups mentioned in this topic (not exhaustive)
note: Order reflects the order these groups are discussed in the doc's separate walkthroughs, not a confirmed Property Editor group order; full Page group list not stated

action: add JavaScript file URLs to load on this page
where: select Page name, Property Editor, JavaScript group, File URLs attribute
appears: multi-line text field, one URL per line
result: those JS files load with the page; supports #MIN#, #MIN_DIRECTORY#, #APP_VERSION# substitution strings

action: add page-scoped JavaScript functions or global variables
where: select Page name, Property Editor, JavaScript group, Function and Global Variable Declaration attribute
appears: code field accepting JavaScript, no script tags
result: code replaces the #PAGE_JAVASCRIPT# substitution string in the page template

action: run JavaScript automatically when the page loads
where: select Page name, Property Editor, JavaScript group, Execute When Page Loads attribute
appears: code field
result: code executes after APEX's own generated page-load JavaScript

action: configure whether URLs to this page can rejoin an existing session
where: select Page name, Property Editor, Security group, Rejoin Sessions attribute
appears: choice of Application Default, Disabled, Enabled for Public Sessions, Enabled for All Sessions
result: controls deep-link session behavior for this page; a stricter instance-level setting can override it

name: Rejoin Sessions options (Page, Security group)
note: Enabling this can expose the app to session takeover; instance-level setting overrides application/page settings

action: configure a page's dialog sizing and behavior
where: select Page name, Property Editor, Appearance group set Page Mode to Modal Dialog or Non-Modal Dialog, then the Dialog group
appears: Dialog group attributes become editable
result: controls the dialog's on-screen presentation

name: Dialog attribute group (Page)
note: Only editable once Page Mode in the Appearance group is Modal Dialog or Non-Modal Dialog

action: warn users before they navigate away with unsaved changes
where: select Page name, Property Editor, Navigation group, Warn on Unsaved Changes attribute, set to On
appears: attribute value toggles to On
result: browser warns the end user leaving the page with unsaved edits, via apex.page.warnOnUnsavedChanges

action: add a region, item, or button by dragging from the Gallery into the Layout tab
where: Central pane Layout tab active, Gallery at bottom, click-hold the control and drag onto the Layout tab
appears: Layout tab shows a darkened yellow tile at valid drop positions while dragging
result: component created at that position; only valid drop positions for that component type accept the drop

action: resolve errors after adding a new component
where: Toolbar Show Messages icon lights up, click it, Messages dialog, select an error
appears: Messages dialog lists errors that must be addressed; selecting one highlights the associated attribute in Property Editor
result: developer fixes the flagged attribute, then Save or Save and Run Page

action: create a new region, sub region, page item, or button from an existing node
where: Left pane Rendering tab, select a region, item or button, right-click for context menu
appears: context menu with commands such as Create Region, Create Sub Region, Create Page Item, Create Button, options vary by node type
result: new component created relative to the selected node

action: reveal legacy component types when creating a component
where: Property Editor, Type attribute dropdown, select Show Legacy...
appears: legacy component types are added into the Type list
result: lets developer pick an older unsupported component type; Oracle does not recommend using them

action: copy a region, item, or button to another location via context menu
where: Layout tab, select component, right-click, context menu, Copy To, choose location
appears: context menu listing valid target locations
result: duplicate of the component created at the chosen location, then edit its attributes

action: copy a region, item, or button by dragging
where: Left pane Rendering tab, select component, hold CTRL, drag with mouse to new location, drop
appears: a copy of the component appears at the new location
result: duplicate created without opening a menu

action: copy a region, item, or button to a different page
where: Left pane Rendering tab, select component, right-click, Copy to other Page
appears: a wizard appears for the copy operation
result: component and its logic is duplicated onto a target page chosen in the wizard

name: Rendering tree placement of regions, items and buttons
items: regions placed at a page position
items and buttons nested inside a region at a region position
note: Regions, items and buttons are added under the overarching Components container, either at a page position or nested inside a region at a region position

name: Pre-Rendering node (Rendering tab)
note: Expand the Pre-Rendering node at the top of the Rendering tab; right-click one of these three points to Create Branch, Create Computation, or Create Process

name: Processing tab tree, page submission points
note: Right-click the identifier or an existing component at one of these points to Create Branch, Create Validation, Create Computation, or Create Process

action: create a branch, computation, or process that runs before rendering
where: Rendering tab, expand Pre-Rendering node, right-click Before Header, After Header, or Before Regions
appears: context menu with Create Branch, Create Computation, Create Process
result: new pre-rendering logic item added at that processing point

action: create a branch, validation, computation, or process that runs on page submission
where: Processing tab, navigate to After Submit, Validating, Processing, or After Processing, right-click the identifier or existing component
appears: context menu with Create Branch, Create Validation, Create Computation, Create Process
result: new submission-time logic item added at that processing point

action: duplicate, delete, or copy a processing component to another page
where: Processing tab, right-click the component, context menu
appears: context menu with duplicate/delete/copy-to-other-page options
result: component removed, duplicated in place, or copied onto a chosen page

action: change the Rendering tab to group components by component type
where: Rendering tab display option (exact control not named in source doc)
appears: tree reorganizes to group by component type instead of by processing point
result: pre-rendering items then must be maintained from the Processing tab instead of the Rendering tab

action: exclude a page component at runtime without deleting it
where: Rendering tab (also available in Dynamic Actions and Processing tabs), right-click the component, context menu, Comment Out
appears: component displays with a line drawn through it in the tree
result: component is excluded from runtime rendering or processing

action: re-include a previously commented-out component
where: Rendering tab (also Dynamic Actions or Processing tabs), right-click the component, context menu, Uncomment
appears: the strikethrough line disappears
result: component becomes active again at runtime

name: Comment Out / Uncomment availability
note: Backed by a build option named Commented Out, shown as a toggle in the tree context menu; only available by default in apps created in APEX 23.2 or later

action: copy the current page
where: Toolbar Create menu, Copy Page
appears: Copy Page Wizard opens
result: starts a multi-step wizard to duplicate this page within this application or into another application

name: Copy Page Wizard steps, Page in this application
items: Page to Copy (Application, Copy From Page, New Page Number, New Page Name, Copy Public Reports, Breadcrumb)
note: Final button is Copy; an alternate path is the Create Page Wizard's Create Page as Copy option

name: Copy Page Wizard steps, Page in another application
items: Page to Copy (Copy from Application, Copy From Page, Copy to New Page Number, New Page Name, Copy Public Reports, Breadcrumb)
note: Final button is Finish not Copy, because cross-application copy adds a Templates mapping step

action: delete the current page
where: Toolbar Utilities menu, Delete Page
appears: Confirm Page Delete page appears
result: clicking Permanently Delete Page removes the page plus its tabs, breadcrumbs and list entries

action: delete multiple pages, or a numeric range of pages, at once
where: App Builder application Utilities, Page Specific Utilities, Cross Page Utilities, Delete Multiple Pages, Delete Pages by Range tab for a range
appears: page picker with checkboxes, or a page-range input on the Delete Pages by Range tab
result: selected or ranged pages deleted after clicking Delete Pages

action: preview the page as end users would see it
where: Toolbar, Save and Run Page button, a green right-facing arrow in the upper right
appears: rendered application page opens
result: on a Global Page reloads the active page or open modal dialog; on a modal dialog page refreshes the dialog if open, else reloads the active page or opens the app's main page

name: Developer Toolbar controls
note: Displays at bottom of any editable runtime page; only shown when Availability, Status on the Application Definition is Available with Developer Toolbar

name: Session menu
note: View Session State shows session state for the current page; Session Overrides opens a dialog listing session values that can be overridden

name: Debug menu
note: Info=log level 4, Debug URL YES; App Trace=level 6, LEVEL6; Full Trace=level 9, LEVEL9, most detail but can slow requests; View Debug displays the log

name: Quick Edit menu
note: Quick Edit Mode: click a component to jump into Page Designer for it, ESCAPE or click outside to exit. Edit Live Template Options: hover the component then click its Wrench icon

name: Customize menu
note: Theme Roller only displays for themes that support it

name: Info menu
items: Show Layout Columns / Hide Layout Columns
note: Show Layout Columns only applies if the layout supports it and the page has more than one column

name: Developer Toolbar Options submenu (gear icon, far right)
note: Display Position options are Top, Left, Bottom, or Right

action: jump from the running page straight into Page Designer
where: Developer Toolbar, click the Page XX (page number) button
appears: Page Designer opens for that page
result: quick round trip from runtime back to editing

action: view current session state values
where: Developer Toolbar, Session menu, View Session State
appears: session state information for the current page
result: developer inspects item values held in session

action: override a session value for testing
where: Developer Toolbar, Session menu, Session Overrides
appears: Session Overrides dialog listing overridable session values
result: developer sets a temporary session value

action: enable debug mode at a chosen detail level
where: Developer Toolbar, Debug menu, Enable Debug, then Info, App Trace, or Full Trace
appears: debug mode turns on for subsequent requests
result: View Debug then shows a log at that detail level, log levels 4, 6, or 9 respectively

action: view the debug log for the current page
where: Developer Toolbar, Debug menu, View Debug
appears: debug information for the current page displays
result: developer inspects render and processing steps and timings

action: jump directly from a rendered component into its Page Designer properties
where: Developer Toolbar, Quick Edit, then click the component on the page
appears: Page Designer opens with that component selected
result: press ESCAPE or click outside a component to exit quick edit mode

action: edit a component's template options live at runtime
where: Developer Toolbar, Quick Edit, hover the component, click the Wrench icon in its upper right corner
appears: Live Template Options editor for that component
result: template option changes apply without a full Page Designer round trip

action: open a live CSS editor for the application theme
where: Developer Toolbar, Customize menu, Theme Roller
appears: Theme Roller live editor for style, colors, rounded corners
result: theme changes preview live; only available for themes that support Theme Roller

action: change the runtime application logo or app icon
where: Developer Toolbar, Customize menu, Edit Logo or Edit App Icon
appears: logo or icon editing dialog
result: updates what end users see as the app logo or icon

action: visualize the page's column grid layout
where: Developer Toolbar, Info menu, Show Layout Columns
appears: grid column overlay drawn on the page; the menu item toggles to Hide Layout Columns
result: see the 12-column grid boundaries at runtime; only if the layout supports it and the page has more than one column

action: view page performance timing
where: Developer Toolbar, Info menu, Show Page Timing
appears: Page Performance Timing dialog
result: Copy button copies timing data as a table; Clear removes the current timing events

action: visualize accessibility landmarks or headings on the page
where: Developer Toolbar, Info menu, Show Landmarks or Show Headings
appears: landmark or heading overlay/list drawn on the page
result: helps verify the accessible structure of the page

action: change how the Developer Toolbar itself displays
where: Developer Toolbar, gear icon Developer Toolbar Options at far right, then Auto Hide, Show Icons Only, or Display Position
appears: toolbar hides until needed, shrinks to icon-only, or moves to Top, Left, Bottom or Right
result: customizes the toolbar's footprint and position

action: notice and investigate a JavaScript error on the page
where: Developer Toolbar, red error button on the left side, appears automatically
appears: red error button, and an alert dialog on click directing to the Browser console
result: button persists until the error is resolved, console cleared, and the page refreshed

name: Ways to create a region
items: From the Rendering Tab: right-click a container, Create Region
From the Gallery: Gallery, Regions tab, right-click a region, context menu
note: A region is a container for content; wizards also create regions automatically when creating an application or page

action: create a region
where: Rendering tab, right-click an existing container, context menu, Create Region
appears: new Region node added; Property Editor shows Title and Type attributes plus type-dependent attributes
result: region added as a container for content; the Type attribute determines how it renders

action: copy a region to another location on the page
where: Layout tab, right-click the region, Copy To, choose destination from the submenu
appears: submenu of valid destinations
result: duplicate of the region created at the destination; Tree regions cannot be copied this way since a Tree region spans more than one region

action: delete one or more regions
where: Rendering tab, select one or more regions, right-click, Delete
appears: selected region(s) marked for removal
result: regions removed from the page after Save

name: Property Editor tabs for a Region
note: Region tab holds general attributes (Identification, Layout, Server Cache, Customization, Advanced, Accessibility); Attributes tab holds settings specific to the region Type, e.g. Region Display Selector's Settings group

action: select a region to edit its attributes
where: Rendering tab, click the region node, or click it in the Layout tab
appears: Property Editor shows the Region tab with that region's attributes
result: developer edits Identification, Layout, Header and Footer, Server Cache, Customization, Advanced, and type-specific Attributes

name: Region, Server Cache, Caching options
note: Enabled caches for all users; Cached by User and Cache by Session scope the cache; a &SESSION. substitution string is cached rather than the literal session ID

name: Region, Customization, Customizable options
items: Customizable and Not Shown By Default
note: Page template must include the #CUSTOMIZE# substitution string for the end-user Customize link to appear

name: Region, Advanced group attributes
note: HTML DOM ID was renamed from the old Static ID (region); #REGION_STATIC_ID# is deprecated in favor of #DOM_ID#; the (new) Static ID field is locked by default, click the Lock icon to unlock

action: add a Region Display Selector to the page
where: Gallery, right-click Region Display Selector region, Add To, choose location, or drag-drop onto the Layout tab
appears: Region Display Selector region added to the page
result: provides show/hide tab controls for regions whose Region Display Selector advanced attribute is On

name: Region Display Selector, Attributes tab, Settings group
items: Remember Last Selection (By User / By Session / No)
note: Mode View Single Region shows tabs with one region visible at a time; Scroll Window shows all regions and a tab click scrolls to it; first Region Display Selector entry is always Show All

name: Ways to create a page item
items: From the Rendering Tab (right-click a region/container, Create Page Item)
From the Gallery (Gallery, Items tab, drag-drop or context menu Add To)
note: Same two entry points documented for regions and buttons

name: Page Item attribute groups referenced in this topic
note: Order follows the doc's own topic sequence; not confirmed as the Property Editor's exact visual group order

action: see which attributes changed since the last save
where: Property Editor, any edited attribute
appears: a green marker displays to the left of the attribute name
result: marker persists until the page is saved, giving a visual diff of pending edits

name: Page Item, Default group, Type options
items: SQL Query returning Colon Delimited List
note: Default value only applies when the item's value is not from session state and the source value is NULL

name: Page Item, Security, Session State Protection level options
items: Restricted - May not be set from browser
note: Restricted option always applies even if Session State Protection is disabled overall

name: Page Item, Quick Picks, Type options
note: Static supports up to ten label/value pairs; Shared List of Values only shows LOV entries with a Quick Pick Rank set; SQL Query needs unique column names or aliases

name: Page Item, Multiple Values group
note: Required for Checkbox Group, List Manager, Select Many, Shuttle; also configurable for Combobox, Popup LOV, Select List; double-quote, backslash, or a four-digit escape sequence, characters are not valid Separator values

name: Page Item, Advanced, Warn on Unsaved Changes options
note: Ignore suits items not based on a database column, e.g. a search item

name: Page Item, Session State, Storage options
note: Per Request is the default for database items created via a Form region wizard; Per User (Disk) is unavailable for those items; Per Request items used in AJAX need Page Items To Submit

action: position a page item at the page level or nested inside a region
where: Property Editor, Layout group, Region attribute, leave empty for page-level or pick a region, then the Position attribute
appears: the item's Position choices update to reflect the chosen container's template positions
result: item renders at that page or region template position

name: Button, Behavior, Action options
items: Redirect to Page in this Application
Redirect to Page in a different Application
note: Submit Page sets REQUEST equal to the Button Name; cross-application redirect requires Deep Linking enabled on the target application's Security attributes

action: create a button
where: Gallery, Buttons tab, right-click a button type, Add To, choose location, or drag to the Layout tab
appears: button added; Property Editor shows button attributes organized in groups
result: new button created at the chosen region and position

action: turn a button into a dropdown menu button
where: select button, Property Editor, Behavior group, Type attribute, select Menu
appears: a menu entry named New appears under a new Menus node beneath the button in the Rendering tab
result: button now opens a dropdown menu instead of acting directly

name: Button Menus node and Menu Entry attributes
items: Menu Entry: Identification, Type = Separator for a divider
note: Right-click Menus and select Create Menu to add another entry; right-click an entry for Comment Out, Uncomment, or Duplicate

action: set where a menu entry or button link points
where: Property Editor, Link group, Target attribute, click No Link Defined
appears: Link Builder - Target dialog opens
result: pick a page via its List of Values and click OK to wire the link

action: hide a button entirely, or show it visibly but disabled
where: select button, Property Editor, Server-side Condition, Type = Never; additionally enable Appearance, Show as Disabled to show it disabled instead of hidden
appears: button shows a strikethrough in the Rendering tab; at runtime it disappears, or renders grayed out if Show as Disabled is also on
result: Never alone removes the button at runtime; adding Show as Disabled keeps it visible but unclickable

name: Button, Behavior, Warn on Unsaved Changes options
note: Do Not Check is recommended for Cancel, Delete, and Apply Changes buttons

action: attach a dynamic action directly beneath a button
where: select button, Property Editor, Behavior group, Type attribute, select Trigger Action
appears: an Execute Server-side Code action node is created under the button in the Rendering tab
result: selecting that node exposes Trigger Action attributes; the button no longer submits or redirects on its own

name: Button, Confirmation group (appears once Requires Confirmation is enabled)
note: Confirmation dialog's Confirm button label matches the button's own label; the button action is delayed until confirmed and skipped if cancelled

name: Dynamic Actions tab, default Events node
note: These Event types display by default under the Events node; right-click Events, or one of these event types, then Create Dynamic Action

action: create a new dynamic action
where: Dynamic Actions tab, right-click Events or an existing event type, Create Dynamic Action
appears: a dynamic action named New is added under a group called Not Specified
result: developer then sets Identification, Execution, When and Client-side Condition attributes to define it

name: Dynamic Action attribute groups
note: Execution includes Sequence, Event Scope, Static Container (jQuery Selector), Type (Immediate/Debounce/Throttle); When includes Event, Selection Type

name: Dynamic Action, Execution, Event Scope options
note: Static unbinds once a triggering element is recreated by Partial Page Refresh; Dynamic stays bound regardless; Once fires only once until a full page reload

name: Dynamic Action, Execution, Type options
note: Debounce fires once after activity settles for a set time; Throttle fires at timed intervals while repeatedly triggered

action: add a True or False action to a dynamic action
where: Dynamic Actions tab, expand the dynamic action node, right-click it, Create TRUE Action or Create FALSE Action
appears: a new action node is added under the True or False branch
result: True actions fire when the Client-side Condition is met, or always if none is defined; False actions fire when the condition is not met

name: Dynamic Actions tree hierarchy
items: Events, e.g. Page Load, Change, Click, Dialog Close
a named dynamic action nested under its event
True: actions that fire when the condition is met, or always if no condition
False: actions that fire when the condition is not met
note: Expand the dynamic action node to reveal True and False branches, then the individual action nodes under each

name: Dynamic Action's individual Action attribute groups
items: Execution (Sequence, Event, Fire When Event Result Is, Fire on Initialization)
note: Fire When Event Result Is is True or False; Action attribute picks from the supported actions list (e.g. Execute JavaScript, Set Value)

name: Branch key attributes
note: A branch instructs APEX to go to a specific page, procedure, or URL; Branch Point sets when APEX considers the branch during processing; full attribute-group order not stated in this doc

name: Validation attribute groups
note: Validation group holds Editable Region, Type, Always Execute; Error group holds Error Message, Display Location, Associated Item

action: create a validation
where: Processing tab, right-click Validations, Create Validation
appears: Validation attributes display in the Property Editor, organized in groups
result: new validation added under Validating, Validations in the tree

action: open an existing validation for editing
where: Processing tab, expand Validating, then Validations, select the validation
appears: Property Editor shows that validation's attributes
result: confirms Validations nest one level under the Validating point in the Processing tree

name: Validation, Error, Display Location options
items: Inline with Field and in Notification
note: On Error Page is required to create a hard error that stops all processing, including further validations

name: Validation, Always Execute options
note: On always runs regardless of the submitting button or item's Execute Validations setting; Off only runs if that button or item has Execute Validations=On

name: Computation attribute groups
note: Identification holds Item Name; Execution Options holds Sequence and Point; Error holds the Error Message shown if the computation fails

action: create a page computation
where: Rendering tab, expand Pre-Rendering or Post-Rendering node, right-click the location, Create Computation
appears: Property Editor shows Computation attributes organized in groups
result: new computation added at that rendering point; the most typical Point value is After Submit

name: Computation, Type options, from the doc's worked example, not exhaustive
note: The doc's own example lists only these four; it states a fuller options list is in the Property Editor Help but does not enumerate it
